scripts.db:generate: sh -c 'if [ -f ../../.env ]; then set -a && . ../../.env && set +a; fi; prisma generate'
scripts.db:migrate: sh -c 'if [ -f ../../.env ]; then set -a && . ../../.env && set +a; fi; prisma migrate dev'
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: sh -c 'if [ -f ../../.env ]; then set -a && . ../../.env && set +a; fi; prisma migrate deploy'

scripts.db:seed: sh -c 'if [ -f ../../.env ]; then set -a && . ../../.env && set +a; fi; tsx prisma/seed.ts'
